claims.assertion: She says celestial bodies can influence people through their consciousness and collective nonlocality; mere lights have little consciousness.

claims.assertion: She distinguishes popular astrology as a shallow shell from a deeper, metaphysical astrology whose rationale she says is hidden from the public.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)

claims.assertion: She says extraterrestrials may be both nonterrestrial and interdimensional, but using a portal alone does not make a traveler interdimensional.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
